writeup: TIC 1007259218 is a newly discovered eclipsing binary star system with an orbital period of just 2.5 days. When the primary star passes in front of its companion, the system's brightness dims by 1.59 percent - a subtle change that was detected with high confidence by automated survey analysis. The signal strength of 61.4 and confirmed difference-imaging detection at 23.3 signal-to-noise ratio provide strong evidence this is a genuine system rather than false detection. Notably, no secondary eclipse was observed, suggesting the companion star may be much fainter than the primary. This system does not appear in existing variable-star catalogs, making it a previously unknown discovery worthy of follow-up observations to better understand its properties.
